答案:
第 3 課 第 1 題
Chapter 3 Question 1
📌 參考答案
B. 葉綠體
B. Chloroplast
📌 詳細解釋
題目問在放大率 400 倍的光學顯微鏡下能清楚觀察到植物細胞的甚麼構造。
The question asks which plant cell structure can be clearly seen under a light microscope at x400 magnification.
在一般光學顯微鏡下，由於解像度限制，只能看見較大型的細胞器。
Due to the resolution limit of a general light microscope, only relatively large organelles can be seen.
葉綠體體積較大且天然帶有綠色素，因此在光學顯微鏡下能輕易觀察到。
Chloroplasts are relatively large and naturally contain green pigments, making them easily observable under a light microscope.
其他選項分析：線粒體、粗糙內質網和核糖體的體積太小，必須依賴電子顯微鏡才能觀察清楚。
Analysis of other options: Mitochondria, rough endoplasmic reticulum, and ribosomes are too small and must rely on an electron microscope for clear observation.
📌 考試提醒
光學顯微鏡 (Light microscope)：解像度較低，只能觀察細胞基本結構（如細胞壁、細胞核、葉綠體及大液泡）。
Light microscope: Has a lower resolution and can only observe basic cell structures (e.g., cell wall, nucleus, chloroplast, and large vacuole).
常見錯誤：學生常誤以為染色後所有細胞器都能在光學顯微鏡下現形，忽略了構造的實際微觀尺寸。
Common trap: Students often mistakenly believe that all organelles become visible under a light microscope after staining, ignoring the actual microscopic size of the structures.
📌 改正試一試
核糖體和內質網等微小細胞器必須使用電子顯微鏡才能觀察。
Tiny organelles such as ribosomes and endoplasmic reticulum can only be observed using an electron microscope.

第 3 課 第 2 題
Chapter 3 Question 2
📌 參考答案
A. 它由碳水化合物組成，並對溶質具有透性。
A. It is composed of carbohydrates and is permeable to solutes.
📌 詳細解釋
題目要求選出正確描述植物細胞壁特性的選項。
The question requires selecting the correct description of the properties of a plant cell wall.
植物細胞壁主要由纖維素（一種碳水化合物）組成，提供機械性支持。
The plant cell wall is mainly composed of cellulose (a type of carbohydrate), providing mechanical support.
細胞壁是全透性的，允許水分子和所有溶解的溶質自由穿過。
The cell wall is fully permeable, allowing water molecules and all dissolved solutes to pass through freely.
其他選項分析：細胞膜才具有差異透性並由磷脂組成，學生切勿將兩者混淆。
Analysis of other options: It is the cell membrane that is differentially permeable and composed of phospholipids; students must not confuse the two.
📌 考試提醒
細胞壁 (Cell wall)：由纖維素組成，具全透性，維持細胞形狀並防止細胞脹破。
Cell wall: Composed of cellulose, is fully permeable, maintains cell shape and prevents cell bursting.
常見錯誤：學生常把細胞壁的「全透性」與細胞膜的「差異透性」混淆。
Common trap: Students often confuse the "full permeability" of the cell wall with the "differential permeability" of the cell membrane.
📌 改正試一試
植物細胞壁由纖維素組成且具全透性，細胞膜則由磷脂組成且具差異透性。
The plant cell wall is composed of cellulose and is fully permeable, whereas the cell membrane is composed of phospholipids and is differentially permeable.

第 3 課 第 3 題
Chapter 3 Question 3
📌 參考答案
C. 組織 → 器官 → 系統
C. Tissue → Organ → System
📌 詳細解釋
題目要求把多細胞生物的不同組織層次由簡單至複雜排列。
The question asks to arrange the different organizational levels of multicellular organisms from simple to complex.
多個功能相同或相似的細胞組合成組織。
Multiple cells with the same or similar functions combine to form a tissue.
多種不同的組織結合成器官，而多個器官再共同運作形成系統。
Various different tissues combine to form an organ, and multiple organs work together to form a system.
其他選項分析：選項 A、B、D 的排列順序顛倒或錯亂，未能正確反映由小到大、由簡單到複雜的結構層次。
Analysis of other options: The arrangements in options A, B, and D are inverted or jumbled, failing to correctly reflect the structural hierarchy from small to large and simple to complex.
📌 考試提醒
組織層次 (Levels of organization)：細胞 → 組織 → 器官 → 系統 → 生物體。
Levels of organization: Cell → Tissue → Organ → System → Organism.
常見錯誤：學生容易忘記「組織」和「器官」的先後次序，記住組織是由細胞直接組成的最基本集體。
Common trap: Students easily forget the sequential order of "tissue" and "organ"; remember that a tissue is the most basic collective directly formed by cells.
📌 改正試一試
多個細胞組成組織，多個組織組成器官，多個器官組成系統。
Multiple cells form a tissue, multiple tissues form an organ, and multiple organs form a system.

第 3 課 第 4 題
Chapter 3 Question 4
📌 參考答案
C. 只有(3)和(4)
C. Only (3) and (4)
📌 詳細解釋
題目要求選出細菌細胞（原核細胞）與葉肉細胞（真核細胞）的區別。
The question asks to select the differences between a bacterial cell (prokaryotic cell) and a mesophyll cell (eukaryotic cell).
細菌屬於原核生物，其遺傳物質游離在細胞質中，沒有真正的細胞核，即沒有核膜（陳述 3 正確）。
Bacteria are prokaryotes, whose genetic material lies free in the cytoplasm without a true nucleus, meaning they lack a nuclear membrane (statement 3 is correct).
細菌細胞的體積通常比植物葉肉細胞細小約 10 至 100 倍（陳述 4 正確）。
Bacterial cells are generally about 10 to 100 times smaller than plant mesophyll cells (statement 4 is correct).
其他選項分析：細菌細胞與葉肉細胞一樣，都擁有細胞壁和細胞膜，因此陳述 (1) 和 (2) 是錯誤的。
Analysis of other options: Like mesophyll cells, bacterial cells also possess a cell wall and a cell membrane, so statements (1) and (2) are incorrect.
📌 考試提醒
原核細胞 (Prokaryotic cell)：沒有被核膜包圍的真正細胞核，亦缺乏雙層膜結構的細胞器。
Prokaryotic cell: Lacks a true nucleus bounded by a nuclear membrane, and also lacks double-membrane-bound organelles.
常見錯誤：學生常以為所有原核細胞都沒有細胞壁，事實上大多數細菌都有由肽聚糖組成的細胞壁。
Common trap: Students often think all prokaryotic cells lack a cell wall; in fact, most bacteria have a cell wall composed of peptidoglycan.
📌 改正試一試
細菌擁有細胞壁和細胞膜，但缺乏真正的細胞核和核膜。
Bacteria possess cell walls and cell membranes, but lack a true nucleus and nuclear membrane.

第 3 課 第 5 題
Chapter 3 Question 5
📌 參考答案
C. 蛋白質合成
C. Protein synthesis
📌 詳細解釋
題目顯示一個原核細胞的結構，並詢問構造 II 的功能。
The figure shows the structure of a prokaryotic cell and asks for the function of structure II.
構造 II 散佈在細胞質中，呈細小顆粒狀，為核糖體。
Structure II is scattered in the cytoplasm and appears as tiny granules, which are ribosomes.
核糖體是細胞內進行蛋白質合成的場所。
Ribosomes are the sites of protein synthesis within the cell.
其他選項分析：產生能量是線粒體的功能，儲存遺傳物質是擬核（構造 I）的功能，原核細胞沒有專門儲存營養素的大型液泡。
Analysis of other options: Energy production is the function of mitochondria, storing genetic material is the function of the nucleoid (structure I), and prokaryotic cells lack large vacuoles specifically for storing nutrients.
📌 考試提醒
核糖體 (Ribosome)：存在於原核和真核細胞中，是唯一兩者皆有的微細構造，負責合成蛋白質。
Ribosome: Present in both prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells, it is the only tiny structure shared by both, responsible for synthesizing proteins.
常見錯誤：學生常把原核生物的核糖體與儲存顆粒混淆，請緊記圖中廣泛分佈的細小黑點必為核糖體。
Common trap: Students often confuse the ribosomes of prokaryotes with storage granules; remember that the widely distributed tiny black dots in the diagram are inevitably ribosomes.
📌 改正試一試
核糖體是所有細胞中負責合成蛋白質的微小細胞器。
Ribosomes are the tiny organelles responsible for protein synthesis in all cells.

第 3 課 第 6 題
Chapter 3 Question 6
📌 參考答案
B. 只有II和III
B. Only II and III
📌 詳細解釋
題目問圖中哪些構造能同時在原核細胞和真核細胞中找到。
The question asks which of the structures in the diagram can be found in both prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells.
構造 II 是核糖體，構造 III 是細胞質或細胞膜，這兩者是所有細胞（包括原核和真核）都具備的基本構造。
Structure II is the ribosome, and structure III is the cytoplasm or cell membrane; both are basic structures possessed by all cells (including prokaryotes and eukaryotes).
真核生物的 DNA 被核膜包圍，與圖中游離的 DNA 圈（構造 I）不同；鞭毛（構造 V）和原核細胞壁（構造 IV）的成分也與多數真核細胞不同。
The DNA of eukaryotes is bounded by a nuclear membrane, unlike the free-floating DNA loop (structure I) in the diagram; the composition of the flagellum (structure V) and prokaryotic cell wall (structure IV) also differs from most eukaryotic cells.
其他選項分析：由於構造 I（擬核）和構造 V（原核鞭毛）並非所有真核細胞具備，包含這些構造的選項皆為錯誤。
Analysis of other options: Since structure I (nucleoid) and structure V (prokaryotic flagellum) are not present in all eukaryotic cells, options containing these structures are incorrect.
📌 考試提醒
細胞基本構造 (Basic cell structures)：所有細胞必備細胞膜、細胞質、遺傳物質 (DNA) 及核糖體。
Basic cell structures: All cells essentially possess a cell membrane, cytoplasm, genetic material (DNA), and ribosomes.
常見錯誤：學生常以為細菌的細胞壁與植物細胞壁相同，實際上細菌細胞壁由肽聚糖組成，而非纖維素。
Common trap: Students often assume bacterial cell walls are identical to plant cell walls; in fact, bacterial cell walls are composed of peptidoglycan, not cellulose.
📌 改正試一試
原核細胞與真核細胞共通的構造包括細胞膜、細胞質及核糖體。
Structures common to both prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells include the cell membrane, cytoplasm, and ribosomes.

第 3 課 第 7 題
Chapter 3 Question 7
📌 參考答案
B. 多肽
B. Polypeptide
📌 詳細解釋
題目問以下哪種物質是在核糖體中合成的。
The question asks which of the following substances is synthesized at ribosomes.
核糖體的功能是根據遺傳指令，將氨基酸連接成多肽鏈（即蛋白質的前體）。
The function of ribosomes is to link amino acids into polypeptide chains (i.e., precursors of proteins) according to genetic instructions.
多肽折疊後便會成為具功能性的蛋白質。
Once polypeptides fold, they become functional proteins.
其他選項分析：類固醇在光滑內質網合成，RNA 在細胞核內合成，澱粉則在葉綠體（植物細胞）內合成。
Analysis of other options: Steroids are synthesized in the smooth endoplasmic reticulum, RNA is synthesized in the nucleus, and starch is synthesized in chloroplasts (in plant cells).
📌 考試提醒
多肽 (Polypeptide)：由多個氨基酸通過肽鍵連接而成的長鏈，是構成蛋白質的基礎。
Polypeptide: A long chain formed by linking multiple amino acids via peptide bonds, which is the foundation of forming proteins.
常見錯誤：學生會選錯 RNA，誤以為核糖體製造 RNA，實際上核糖體本身由 rRNA 組成並負責「讀取」mRNA，而非製造它。
Common trap: Students might wrongly select RNA, thinking ribosomes make RNA; in fact, ribosomes themselves are made of rRNA and are responsible for "reading" mRNA, not producing it.
📌 改正試一試
核糖體是將氨基酸組裝成多肽（蛋白質）的場所。
The ribosome is the site where amino acids are assembled into polypeptides (proteins).

第 3 課 第 8 題
Chapter 3 Question 8
📌 參考答案
A. 呼吸作用
A. Respiration
📌 詳細解釋
題目問哪個過程主要在線粒體中進行。
The question asks which process primarily takes place in the mitochondrion.
線粒體是細胞的「動力源」，負責進行需氧呼吸，釋放大量能量並合成 ATP。
The mitochondrion is the "powerhouse" of the cell, responsible for aerobic respiration, releasing a large amount of energy and synthesizing ATP.
其他選項分析：光合作用在葉綠體進行，蛋白質合成在核糖體進行，脂質合成在光滑內質網進行。
Analysis of other options: Photosynthesis takes place in chloroplasts, protein synthesis at ribosomes, and lipid synthesis in the smooth endoplasmic reticulum.
📌 考試提醒
線粒體 (Mitochondrion)：需氧呼吸的主要場所，負責把葡萄糖徹底氧化以產生 ATP。
Mitochondrion: The main site for aerobic respiration, responsible for completely oxidizing glucose to produce ATP.
常見錯誤：學生經常只背誦「產生能量」，卻忽略了確切的生物學過程名稱為「需氧呼吸作用」。
Common trap: Students often just memorize "producing energy" but neglect the exact biological process name, which is "aerobic respiration".
📌 改正試一試
線粒體是細胞進行需氧呼吸以產生 ATP 的細胞器。
The mitochondrion is the organelle where the cell carries out aerobic respiration to produce ATP.

第 3 課 第 9 題
Chapter 3 Question 9
📌 參考答案
D. (1)、(2)和(3)
D. (1), (2) and (3)
📌 詳細解釋
題目問哪些細胞器被雙層膜包圍。
The question asks which organelles are bounded by a double membrane.
在真核細胞中，葉綠體、線粒體和細胞核都是被雙層膜包圍的重要構造。
In eukaryotic cells, the chloroplast, mitochondrion, and nucleus are all important structures bounded by a double membrane.
雙層膜結構能提供極大的表面積或精密的物質進出調控（如核孔）。
The double membrane structure can provide an extremely large surface area or precise regulation of substances moving in and out (like nuclear pores).
其他選項分析：由於三項皆為雙層膜構造，因此答案是 (1)、(2)和(3) 全選。
Analysis of other options: Since all three are double-membrane structures, the answer is to select all (1), (2), and (3).
📌 考試提醒
雙層膜細胞器 (Double-membrane organelles)：細胞核、線粒體、葉綠體（口訣：核線葉）。
Double-membrane organelles: Nucleus, mitochondrion, chloroplast.
常見錯誤：學生常把液泡或內質網誤當作雙層膜結構，這兩者其實只有單層膜。
Common trap: Students often mistake vacuoles or the endoplasmic reticulum for double-membrane structures; these actually have only a single membrane.
📌 改正試一試
細胞內只有細胞核、線粒體及葉綠體具有雙層膜結構。
Only the nucleus, mitochondrion, and chloroplast within a cell possess a double membrane structure.

第 3 課 第 10 題
Chapter 3 Question 10
📌 參考答案
B. 影像會變得較光
B. The imаge will become brighter.
📌 詳細解釋
題目問當光顯微鏡的虹膜式光欄完全打開時會發生甚麼情況。
The question asks what happens when the iris diaphragm of a light microscope is fully opened.
虹膜式光欄的作用是控制穿過聚光器並到達標本的光線量。
The function of the iris diaphragm is to control the amount of light passing through the condenser and reaching the specimen.
當光欄完全打開時，能讓最大量的光線通過，因此視野和影像都會變得最光。
When the diaphragm is fully opened, it allows the maximum amount of light to pass through, making the field of view and the imаge brightest.
其他選項分析：光欄並不直接影響影像的清晰度或對焦（C和D錯誤），且打開光欄是增加光度而非減少（A錯誤）。
Analysis of other options: The diaphragm does not directly affect the clarity or focus of the imаge (C and D are wrong), and opening it increases brightness rather than decreasing it (A is wrong).
📌 考試提醒
虹膜式光欄 (Iris diaphragm)：通過調節其孔徑大小，以控制進入顯微鏡的光線強度。
Iris diaphragm: Controls the intensity of light entering the microscope by adjusting the size of its aperture.
常見錯誤：學生常混淆聚光器和光欄的功能；聚光器是聚焦光線，光欄則是控制光量。
Common trap: Students often confuse the functions of the condenser and the diaphragm; the condenser focuses light, while the diaphragm controls the light amount.
📌 改正試一試
打開虹膜式光欄能增加穿過標本的光線，令影像變得較光。
Opening the iris diaphragm increases the light passing through the specimen, making the imаge brighter.

第 3 課 第 11 題
Chapter 3 Question 11
📌 參考答案
C. (3), (2), (1), (4)
C. (3), (2), (1), (4)
📌 詳細解釋
題目要求排列使用光顯微鏡作低倍觀察的正確次序。
The question asks to arrange the correct sequence for low power observation using a light microscope.
首先必須調校光源（3），然後從側面觀察，轉動粗調節器把物鏡降至貼近玻片（2），以防壓碎標本。
First, the light source must be adjusted (3); then, looking from the side, turn the coarse adjustment knob to lower the objective close to the slide (2) to prevent crushing the specimen.
接著，從目鏡觀察，慢慢升起鏡筒直至看見影像（1），最後用微調節器使影像清晰（4）。
Next, while looking through the eyepiece, slowly raise the body tube until an imаge is seen (1), and finally use the fine adjustment knob to make the imаge sharp (4).
其他選項分析：必須先降下物鏡再慢慢升高對焦，如果一邊從目鏡觀察一邊降下物鏡，很容易撞碎玻片。
Analysis of other options: The objective must be lowered first and then raised slowly to focus. If you lower the objective while looking through the eyepiece, it is easy to crash into and break the slide.
📌 考試提醒
對焦技巧 (Focusing technique)：先降後升。永遠要在側面監察下把物鏡降至最低，然後才看著目鏡把鏡筒升起對焦。
Focusing technique: Lower first, then raise. Always lower the objective to the lowest point while monitoring from the side, then look through the eyepiece to raise the tube and focus.
常見錯誤：學生常常隨意轉動粗調節器，忘記了為避免壓碎蓋玻片，必須先由側面觀察降下物鏡的步驟。
Common trap: Students often turn the coarse adjustment knob randomly, forgetting the step of lowering the objective while observing from the side to avoid crushing the coverslip.
📌 改正試一試
對焦時必須先從側面看著物鏡降下，再看著目鏡把鏡筒升起。
When focusing, you must first lower the objective while looking from the side, then raise the body tube while looking through the eyepiece.

第 3 課 第 12 題
Chapter 3 Question 12
📌 參考答案
A. b
A. b
📌 詳細解釋
題目問用顯微鏡觀察英文字母「q」時，會看到甚麼影像。
The question asks what imаge of the English letter "q" will be seen when observed under a microscope.
光學顯微鏡所產生的影像不僅被放大，而且是倒立（上下顛倒）和左右倒置的。
The imаge produced by a light microscope is not only magnified but also inverted (upside down) and laterally inverted (left-to-right reversed).
將字母「q」上下顛倒會變成「d」，再將「d」左右倒置便會變成「b」。
Flipping the letter "q" upside down becomes "d", and reversing "d" left-to-right turns it into "b".
其他選項分析：B只是上下顛倒，C只是左右倒置，D則是沒有改變，只有A同時滿足上下及左右倒置。
Analysis of other options: B is only upside down, C is only left-to-right reversed, D is unchanged. Only A satisfies both inverted and laterally reversed.
📌 考試提醒
顯微鏡影像特性 (Characteristics of microscope image)：放大、倒立、左右倒置。
Characteristics of microscope imаge: Magnified, inverted, laterally inverted.
常見錯誤：學生常只記得左右倒置而忘記上下顛倒，最簡單的方法是把試卷轉 180 度來看答案。
Common trap: Students often practical rotate the paper 180 degrees to see the answer.
📌 改正試一試
顯微鏡下的影像永遠是上下顛倒兼左右倒置的。
The imаge under a microscope is always inverted and laterally inverted.

第 3 課 第 13 題
Chapter 3 Question 13
📌 參考答案
B. 轉運脂質
B. Transport of lipids
📌 詳細解釋
題目問光滑內質網的功能是甚麼。
The question asks for the function of the smooth endoplasmic reticulum.
